desc1: Beyond the Horizon is a student enterprise dedicated to creating personal growth. Through active discussions and independent explorations in various areas of development, students can engage with themselves & with each other on innovative ideas.
desc2: We often hold weekly meetings where one member prepares a Google Slides presentation to share with others about their current interest relating to ideas of self-growth. This allows a balanced observation of various aspects of development, rather than committing to only one.
desc3: There is no other organisation within this school which promotes learning in the long-term, which would benefit students after they leave school. We prepare for our members to be ready for their future, whatever that may be.

desc1: The Cubing Enterprise is dedicated to fostering problem-solving, spatial reasoning, and creative thinking through speedcubing. Our initiative brings together students of all skill levels to master various puzzles, from classic 3x3 Rubik's cubes to complex non-standard variants. We actively enrich school life by organizing exciting Junior School house competitions, building school spirit, and encouraging friendly rivalry. Beyond competitive solving, we explore the artistic and engineering aspects of cubing by designing creative mosaic art and custom structures using puzzle blocks. Ultimately, our enterprise aims to build an inclusive community centered on the cube.
desc2: Our meetings are usually for lessons, as we have beginner to advanced level cubers that we teach. On special occasions, we will bring in creative activites to endorse in, making cubing much more fun and engaging. Sometimes, we will hold inner competitions between us to measure our ability in the subject. We have a tradition of hosting and organizing internal house competitions(mainly in the junior school) for cubing, and we will be hosting it this year as well.
desc3: Our Cubing Enterprise stands out by blending logic, competition, and visual art into a unique hands-on platform. While many wonderful enterprises focus on valuable community service and traditional projects, we offer a complementary space dedicated to cognitive skill-building and creative design. We go beyond teaching speedcubing algorithms by using cubes as an artistic medium, constructing large-scale mosaics and original structures that transform abstract problem-solving into tangible art. By organizing energetic Junior School house competitions, we also bridge age groups and build vibrant school spirit, providing a fresh way for students to challenge their minds, collaborate, and express their creativity.

desc1: Our enterprise explores not only music itself, but also the business and industry surrounding it, including industry trends, marketing strategies, and patterns of consumer behavior. Throughout the term, each member will select an album of their choice, write an in-depth review, and have their work published on our official website. For students who are interested in music, business, marketing, or cultural and consumer trends, we hope this enterprise will provide them with a unique opportunity to develop analytical and writing skills while engaging with music from a broader perspective.
desc2: Throughout the term, each member will select an album of their choice, write an in-depth review, and have their work published on our official website. (offrecord.international)
desc3: What makes our enterprise unique is that we approach music from beyond a merely artistic perspective. By combining music criticism with marketing, consumer analysis, and cultural / political influences, members explore how the music industry operates and how cultural trends influence both artists and audiences. Rather than simply discussing whether an album is ‘good’ or ‘bad,’ we intend to examine the wider context, including, promotion, external influences, and industry trends. Each member of the enterprise also produces an in-depth album review covering most of these aspects, which is then published on our official website, giving students the opportunity to develop their own critical voice while creating a tangible piece of published work.
